Alleged Leaked Photo of Rani Mukerji and Abhishek Bachchan Surfaces

An alleged leaked photograph featuring actors Rani Mukerji and Abhishek Bachchan has surfaced online, sparking speculation about their potential involvement in an upcoming Shah Rukh Khan film titled 'King'.
